headline: Returns to operating profit as revenue surges
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 4.69T, up 52.6% y/y, and operating profit was KRW 407.8B against a KRW 591.3B loss a year earlier.
summary_long: Preliminary results show a swing to operating profit from a loss of KRW 591.3B in the same quarter last year. Reported revenue and operating profit include KRW 122.5B of manufacturing tax credits. Yahoo EPS of KRW 7,630 compares with KRW 4,348 last quarter. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue and operating profit come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage of preliminary results. Shard operating income (KRW 1,371B) does not match the reported KRW 407.8B and is not used. EPS is Yahoo data and may be on a different basis than reported net profit.
